title: docs: Add README for OctoAcme Project Management Docs — summary & links
head: octoacme-add-readme
body:
Closes #2

Add README for OctoAcme Project Management docs with summary and links.

This PR adds docs/README.md as the central entry point for the OctoAcme project management process documentation. It summarizes the core principles, lifecycle phases, key artifacts, and role-focused entry points. See the new file for links to the detailed docs in the docs/ folder.
